The most prominent sign is angled and displays red text on a white background, appearing to read 'ONE WAY' or similar, though the text is distorted. Below it are two horizontal rectangular signs with white text on dark backgrounds, also exhibiting garbled or nonsensical lettering. The scene is characterized by high contrast between the glowing signs and the pitch-black background.
